entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The vast span of human existence before the invention of writing (c. 3200 BCE in Mesopotamia), encompassing over 99% of human history. From the earliest stone tools (3.3 million years ago) through the agricultural revolution (c. 10,000 BCE), prehistoric peoples developed language, art, religion, agriculture, and social organization — the foundations of all subsequent civilization.
